chunks: Narrated to us Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Sinani (may Allah have mercy on him), he said: Narrated to us Ahmad b. Yahya b. Zakariyya al-Qattan, he said: Narrated to us Bakr b. 'Abdullah b. Habib, he said: Narrated to us al-Fadl b. al-Saqr al-'Abdi, he said: Narrated to us Abu Mu'awiya, from Sulayman b. Mihran al-A'mash, from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father Muhammad b. 'Ali, from his father 'Ali b. al-Husayn (upon them be peace), he said:

We are the Imams of the Muslims, and the Proofs of Allah over the worlds, and the chiefs of the believers, and the leaders of the shining and distinguished ones, and the masters of the believers. We are a safeguard for the people of the earth, just as the stars are a safeguard for the people of the sky. We are those through whom Allah holds up the sky from falling upon the earth except by His permission, and through us He holds the earth from shaking with its people, and through us He sends down the rain, and through us He spreads mercy, and He brings out the blessings of the earth. Had it not been for what is on the earth of us, it would have caved in with its people.

He (upon him be peace) said: And the earth has not been empty since Allah created Adam of a Proof of Allah upon it, apparent and known, or hidden and concealed, and it will not be empty until the Hour rises of a Proof of Allah upon it. Had it not been for that, Allah would not be worshiped.
Sulayman said: So I said to al-Sadiq (upon him be peace): Then how will the people benefit from the hidden and concealed Proof? He said: Just as they benefit from the sun when clouds conceal it (1).

ai.seo_question: What is the cosmic role of the Imams and how does the Hidden Imam benefit humanity?
ai.summary: Imam 'Ali b. al-Husayn (Zayn al-'Abidin), the Fourth Imam, declares the cosmic role of the Ahl al-Bayt. Speaking to the early Muslim community still grieving from the tragedy of Karbala, the Imam affirms that the Imams are the divinely appointed leaders of Muslims, the Proofs of Allah over all creation, and the means through which God sustains the cosmos — holding up the heavens, stabilizing the earth, sending rain, and spreading mercy. He states that the earth has never been devoid of a divine Proof since the creation of Adam, whether apparent or hidden, and will not be until the Day of Judgment. When al-A'mash asks Imam al-Sadiq how people benefit from a concealed Proof, the Imam replies with the famous sun-behind-clouds parable: just as the sun still benefits people even when obscured by clouds, so too does the Hidden Imam benefit humanity even in occultation.
